text: A retry starts from the base and redoes all the work, even when the rejected candidate passed every check and failed only a content criterion such as a missing change description: job 20261024-161559-rxjg passed fmt, clippy and 1094 tests and was rejected only for criterion 7 (a change description listing callers), and its retry costs about 40 minutes and 3 dollars to redo the code (job 20261023-234313-h49d was the same, rejected over one CHANGELOG line). When every check passed and the unmet criteria are content criteria, let the retry start from the rejected candidate's tree and send the producer only the findings, keeping the full verification of the new candidate.
